label: Aid worker incidents (killed/injured/kidnapped/arrested) (national)
source: Insecurity Insight (SiND) via HDX, CC BY-SA 4.0 - 1997-2026 SSD Aid Worker KIKA Incident Data.xlsx
native_resolution: national (coordinates censored by source; state in points layer)
aggregation: count of incidents per month, national (county_id SS) - broadcast to all counties
notes: NATIONAL ONLY: Insecurity Insight publishes South Sudan incidents with censored coordinates (Admin 1 only), so no county breakdown is possible. Coverage 2018-01..2025-12 (464 incidents; 10 without a usable state). Based on open-source/media and partner reports: counts reflect reporting intensity as much as incidence. State-level counts: data/processed/insecurity_insight/ii_state_monthly.csv; incidents are in the points layer 'insecurity_insight' at state centroids.
